senses.definition: vb. be tender, weak, soft (Arabic رَكَّ, Aramaic רְכַךְ (in der. spec. and deriv.), ܪܰܟ, id.);—
Pf. 3 ms. רַךְ 2 K 22:19; 2 Ch 34:27; 3 pl. רַכּוּ ψ 55:22; Impf. יֵרַךְ (Ges§ 67 p) Is 7:4 +;—
be timid, fearful, ‖ יָרֵא, Is 7:4; Je 51:46; Dt 20:3.
be softened, penitent, ‖ כָּנַע Niph., 2 K 22:19 = 2 Ch 34:27
be soft, of treacherous words ψ 55:22 (c. מִן comp.; ‖ II. חָלַק).
Pf. 3 fs. רֻכְּכָה Is 1:6 it has not been softened, mollified, with oil (of wound, מַכָּה).
Pf. 3 ms. וְאֵל הֵרַךְ לִבִּי Jb 23:16 (Ges§ 67 v), causat. of Qal 1 a.
